declared_end: Verify that Human state/history and source-linked Wisdom can be modelled without activating artificial cognition, while Wisdom remains contextual rather than causal authority for the Human response.

human_activation.role: Human current state, priority structure and decision production

wisdom_activation.role: contextual applicability principle: identical external input need not produce identical response when relevant path history/current state differ
wisdom_activation.forbidden_role: Wisdom does not select or execute the Human response

asi_activation.role: provenance, cross-domain interpretation, Wisdom applicability, uncertainty and audit only

hard_invariants: AI is not required merely because a Sourceborn system is analysing a Human + Wisdom case.
Human response remains attributed to Human state/history/decision, not to Wisdom.
Wisdom applicability is conditional and can be false.
The same external input may coexist with different Human responses when relevant Human state/history differs.
The Wisdom Candidate remains source-linked and provisional.
ASI may audit applicability/provenance but does not become the Human decision-maker.
